title: Only Happens Here: 10 Traditions That Make No Sense Anywhere Else
description: From signing a 150-year-old ledger to planting native ferns in the heart of campus, Drew University's traditions are deeply rooted in its wooded environment and Methodist history.

cards.title: Signing the 150-Year-Old Ledger
cards.subtitle: A rite of passage for new scholars
cards.notes: Join generations of Drewids by signing the historic matriculation book in Craig Chapel, a tradition dating back to the school's 1867 founding.
cards.short_summary: Incoming students formally enter the university community by signing a historic ledger that dates back to 1867.
cards.evidence_claim: The matriculation book signing is a 150-year-old tradition for all incoming students, linking them to generations of Drew scholars.
cards.source_title: Drew Theological School DMin Students Sign Matriculation Book
cards.access_notes: Occurs during the Fall Matriculation Service in Craig Chapel for new students.

cards.title: The Annual Reforestation
cards.subtitle: Planting native ferns in the Forest
cards.notes: Celebrate Earth Day by planting native ferns and wildflowers to restore the campus ecosystem under the university's majestic oaks.
cards.short_summary: An annual Earth Day event where students and faculty plant native vegetation to maintain the university's 'Forest' identity.
cards.evidence_claim: Fern Fest is an annual event where students replenish native ferns and wildflowers to protect the campus ecosystem.
cards.source_title: Fern Fest Returns After Two-Year Hiatus - The Drew Acorn
cards.access_notes: Held annually in April near the center of campus.

cards.title: The Senior Countdown
cards.subtitle: Celebrating 99 days to graduation
cards.notes: Seniors gather exactly 99 nights before commencement to toast their time at Drew and begin the final countdown to graduation.
cards.short_summary: A milestone celebration for seniors held 99 days before their graduation ceremony.
cards.evidence_claim: 99 Nights is a tradition where seniors celebrate the 99th night before graduation, kicking off the countdown to Commencement.
cards.source_title: Discover Rich Traditions at Drew University
cards.access_notes: Exclusive to the senior class; typically held in the Ehinger Center.

cards.title: The Renaissance Shindig
cards.subtitle: Medieval revelry at Bowne Hall
cards.notes: Step back to the 13th century with human chess, turkey legs, and knighting ceremonies in the shadow of the castle-like S.W. Bowne Hall.
cards.short_summary: A medieval-themed festival featuring period-accurate games, food, and performances organized by 'That Medieval Thing'.
cards.evidence_claim: MedFest is an annual Renaissance-style festival featuring human chess and knighting ceremonies at S.W. Bowne Hall.
cards.source_title: Discover Rich Traditions at Drew University
cards.access_notes: Open to the public; held annually in the spring near S.W. Bowne Hall.

cards.title: A Cappella Harmony Night
cards.subtitle: The ultimate vocal showcase
cards.notes: Experience the harmony of Drew's three a cappella groups—36 Madison Ave, All of the Above, and On a Different Note—in one massive concert.
cards.short_summary: A major semester-end concert featuring all of the university's student-run a cappella ensembles.
cards.evidence_claim: JamFest is a single-night event that unites all of Drew's a cappella groups for a major performance.
cards.source_title: 36 Madison Avenue Celebrates 36 Years of A Capella - The Drew Acorn
cards.access_notes: Typically held in the Dorothy Young Center for the Arts or the Ehinger Center.

cards.title: The Ranger Pitch
cards.subtitle: Student business ideas on stage
cards.notes: Watch students pitch business ideas to a panel of alumni and experts in this semi-annual competition, formerly known as Shark Tank.
cards.short_summary: An entrepreneurial competition where students present product ideas for feedback and potential funding.
cards.evidence_claim: Bear Den, formerly Shark Tank, is a semi-annual event where students pitch business ideas to faculty and alumni.
cards.source_title: Discover Rich Traditions at Drew University
cards.access_notes: Held in the Ehinger Center; open to student spectators.

cards.title: The Final Vigil
cards.subtitle: A glowing farewell to the Forest
cards.notes: Gather by candlelight on the night before graduation to reflect on your time in the Forest and prepare for the world beyond.
cards.short_summary: A reflective, candlelit gathering for graduating seniors held on the eve of commencement.
cards.evidence_claim: The Senior Ceremony is held the night before graduation, where students gather by candlelight to mark their time at Drew.
cards.source_title: Discover Rich Traditions at Drew University
cards.access_notes: Exclusive to the graduating class; held outdoors on the campus grounds.

cards.title: The High-Energy Arrival
cards.subtitle: Upperclassmen hauling your gear
cards.notes: Experience the roar of the Welcome Crew as they cheer for every car and carry your belongings to your new dorm room.
cards.short_summary: A high-energy move-in tradition where student volunteers assist new arrivals with their luggage and gear.
cards.evidence_claim: On Move-In Day, the Drew Welcome Crew erupts into cheers and helps new students carry their belongings to their rooms.
cards.source_title: Discover Rich Traditions at Drew University
cards.access_notes: Occurs on the official new student move-in day in August.

cards.title: The Formal Holiday Gala
cards.subtitle: Cocktail attire and cider fountains
cards.notes: Dress up for the annual formal dance featuring chocolate fountains, cookie decorating, and a winter wonderland transformation of the EC.
cards.short_summary: A long-standing formal holiday dance for the entire student body, traditionally known as the Holiday Ball.
cards.evidence_claim: The Winter Ball (formerly Holiday Ball) is a long-standing tradition where students dress in cocktail attire for a festive evening.
cards.source_title: Students Have a Ball at Winter Ball - The Drew Acorn
cards.access_notes: Held in December at the Ehinger Center; tickets required.

cards.title: The Alumni Homecoming
cards.subtitle: Rangers returning to the Forest
cards.notes: Celebrate school spirit with alumni games, the Hall of Fame ceremony, and varsity doubleheaders at Ranger Stadium.
cards.short_summary: The university's athletic homecoming weekend featuring alumni reunions and major sporting events.
cards.evidence_claim: Ranger Weekend is a yearly tradition of welcoming alumni back to the Forest for athletic games and ceremonies.
cards.source_title: Ranger Weekend to be Held Oct. 18-19 - Drew University Athletics
cards.access_notes: Held annually in October; events take place across various athletic facilities.
